Chapter 898: Chapter 4: Five Hundred Years of History (Please Subscribe)

Cangwu Immortal City.

Outside the Cave Mansion Area, there is a palace situated.

The palace is called ‘Flying Immortal Hall’, which is the place dedicated to the sale and purchase of cave dwellings in Cangwu Immortal City.

Moreover, every million years, the owners of the cave dwellings must return to this palace to replace the jade token used for entering and exiting their cave dwellings.

This is done to confirm the identity of the immortals residing in the cave dwellings.

The cultivation environment within the Immortal City’s cave dwellings is extremely beneficial, so after many owners pass away, their Cave Dwelling Jade Tokens often fall into the hands of others.

With the jade token, those who are not the cave dwelling owners can also enter and cultivate.

The replacement of the jade token every million years is therefore meant to re-verify the identity of the current residents of the cave dwellings.

Flying Immortal Hall is divided into four layers, occupying a vast area.

At the entrance of the first layer, a large number of immortals in the Mahayana Realm come and go; this level corresponds to the Ding grade cave dwellings.

Generally, immortals in the Mahayana Realm can bite the bullet and purchase them.

The entrance to the second layer of the palace sees very few immortals entering and exiting.

This level corresponds to the Bing grade cave dwellings.

Basically, only a handful of immortals at the pinnacle of Mahayana, or simply Golden Immortals, have the capability to purchase them.

And a Golden Immortal, already able to dominate a region, even within the Immortal City, holds a certain status.

As for the entrances of the third and fourth layers, they are utterly silent.

The third layer corresponds to the Jia grade cave dwellings, which only relatively powerful Golden Immortals have the resources to purchase.

And the fourth layer, corresponds to the topmost A grade cave dwellings.

These are the cave dwellings with the highest regulations in Cangwu Immortal City, and only Jade Immortals have the foundation to purchase them.

Even among the top-tier Golden Immortals, those who can become masters of such dwellings are fewer than the Jade Immortals.

Lin Yuan glanced and headed straight to the fourth layer of ‘Flying Immortal Hall’.

The fourth layer is spacious and vast, and as Lin Yuan enters,

two charming immortal women came up to meet him.

“Greetings Immortal Monarch.”

The two immortal women spoke respectfully.

Although the fourth layer of Flying Immortal Hall does not restrict entry or exit,

those immortals who dare to come here certainly have enough confidence.

“My Cave Dwelling Jade Token is lost, I’ve come to apply for a replacement,” Lin Yuan said in a calm tone.

Of course, the jade token for entering and exiting the A grade cave dwelling of Cangwu Immortal City had fallen into the hands of demons with Yun Zhenzi’s death.

However, the cave dwellings of each great Immortal City are bound to the identity of the corresponding immortal, with soul True Spirit essence as the specific confirmation method.

Even if the jade token is lost, it’s still possible to obtain a replacement with the corresponding soul True Spirit essence.

“Please state your cave dwelling sequence, Immortal Monarch…”

The immortal woman was shocked, her attitude becoming even more respectful.

Going to the fourth layer of Flying Immortal Hall to apply for a replacement token? Doesn’t that mean the cave dwelling corresponding to the lost jade token is an A grade dwelling?

In other words, does this young Immortal Monarch in front of her not come to inquire about purchasing an A grade cave dwelling,

but already possesses one?

“Cangwu A three-six-five-four-three-seven…”

Lin Yuan directly stated the cave dwelling sequence.

Even for Yun Zhenzi, this was one of the very few top-tier cave dwellings.

“Immortal Monarch, please wait a moment.”

The immortal woman quickly checked, within Flying Immortal Hall, where the detailed information of all cave dwellings is recorded.

“Immortal Monarch, please infuse your soul True Spirit essence into this marrow stone.”

The immortal woman on the right took out a grey stone and respectfully said.

The grey stone, known as the marrow stone, is specially used for replicating and recording the essence of a soul’s True Spirit.

When Yun Zhenzi purchased the A grade cave dwelling, he imprinted his soul True Spirit essence within it.

In order to apply for a replacement of the Cave Dwelling Jade Token, Lin Yuan must match the same soul True Spirit essence with the essence inside the marrow stone.

Humming sounds echoed.

With a thought from Lin Yuan, a wisp of Yun Zhenzi’s Jade Immortal consciousness’s soul True Spirit essence merged into the marrow stone.

After a while.

The immortal woman holding the marrow stone spoke respectfully, “The conditions for reissuing are met, please wait a moment, Immortal Monarch.”

After speaking, the immortal woman respectfully stepped back and returned shortly after.

“This is your Cave Dwelling Jade Token.”

The immortal woman presented a white jade token, offering it to Lin Yuan with utmost respect.

“Hm,” Lin Yuan nodded, took the jade token, and turned to leave the Flying Immoral Hall.

After leaving the Flying Immortal Hall, Lin Yuan directly entered the Cave Mansion Area.

Cangwu Immortal City’s Cave Mansion Area is shrouded with many lethal formations.

Any immortal who does not meet the criteria and dares to break in will be slain by the killing formations immediately.

Lin Yuan, holding the Cave Dwelling Jade Token, naturally has the qualifications to enter the Cave Mansion Area.

….

Flying Immortal Hall.

A mysterious space on a certain floor.

A middle-aged man is meditating with his eyes closed.

He is the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, one of the giants of Cangwu Immortal City.

“Hm?”

The middle-aged man seemed to sense something, his eyes swiftly opened, “Cangwu A three-six-five-four-three-seven’s Cave Dwelling Jade Token has been successfully reissued?”

“Hall Master.”

A figure materialized beside him, nodding and speaking, “Just now, someone has entered this Grade A Cave Mansion.”

Every Grade A Cave Mansion in Cangwu Immortal City was well-known and had a specific owner, either belonging to a Jade Immortal or those top-tier Golden Immortals with great hopes of stepping into the Jade Immortal Realm.

“If my memory serves me right, this Grade A Cave Mansion has been silent for nearly ten million years?”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall showed a contemplative expression on his face, “The owner of this Grade A Cave Mansion was Yun Zhenzi…”

As the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, he had the privilege to check the information of each mansion.

“Yun Zhenzi? Rumored to have perished in the last great war between immortals and demons, who would have thought he was still alive.”

Hearing this, the figure beside him could not help but exclaim in astonishment.

Among the many Jade Immortals, Yun Zhenzi had a significant reputation.

If not for the besieging by more than a dozen demonic creatures, with Yun Zhenzi’s strength, even if he could not win, he would have been able to retreat with his whole body.

“It seems that the corruption from those demonic creatures in the Demon Abyss did not lead to Yun Zhenzi’s complete demise.”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall nodded slightly.

He quickly inferred what had happened.

Almost ten million years ago, Yun Zhenzi’s true body perished at the hands of numerous demonic creatures, and the subsequent corruption had erased most of his means for revival.

Yet, with Yun Zhenzi’s capabilities, there remained one or two deeply hidden revival techniques that resisted the corruption.

After nearly ten million years, these one or two revival techniques met the conditions for revival, enabling Yun Zhenzi’s successful return.

Such incidents were not uncommon among the many Jade Immortals.

How could one who has cultivated to the level of a Jade Immortal die so easily? They all had multiple back-up plans.

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall had no particular thoughts about those Jade Immortals returning from revival, nor would he do anything about it.

As a giant of the Immortal City, the Hall Master’s status towered above the vast majority of Jade Immortals, and naturally, he paid no heed to Yun Zhenzi’s wealth.

“Yun Zhenzi’s survival is also a good thing, as the great war between immortals and demons will soon begin anew, with a clear increase in the number of demonic lords recently.”

“If Yun Zhenzi can recover all his strength before the war, he could indeed alleviate some pressure from the Immortal City.”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall murmured softly to himself.

The great war between immortals and demons was undoubtedly the cruelest battle in the Immortal Realm.

For most immortals, it was no different from a slaughterhouse.

Jade Immortals still possessed the capability for revival.

But those Golden Immortals and even lower ranks could hardly withstand the corruption from demonic creatures.

Once dead, they were truly dead.

The revival techniques of Golden Immortals seldom could resist the corruption of demons.

Every great war caused the fall of innumerable immortals, and many Jade Immortals would disappear as a result.

“Assuming Yun Zhenzi’s identity to take over the Grade A Cave Mansion is unlikely to fool the upper echelons of the Immortal City.”

Lin Yuan knew all the memories of Yun Zhenzi and was aware that the information about the owner of the mansion wasn’t a secret to the higher-ups of the Cangwu Immortal City.

“But what of it? I am Yun Zhenzi now.”

Lin Yuan remained unconcerned, grasping Yun Zhenzi’s fragment of the Jade Immortal consciousness, virtually holding Yun Zhenzi hostage.

Who could question his identity, given his insight into all the latter’s memories?

Yun Zhenzi, being a Jade Immortal, could hardly be suppressed by a peer-level Jade Immortal, even in his weakened state.

Those capable of suppressing Yun Zhenzi to the level of a Jade Immortal would not deign to impersonate Yun Zhenzi.

With Lin Yuan’s current methods, unless the Ancestral Master intervened, outsiders would not be able to see through him.

And the Ancestral Master? Such a lofty existence, so high above, how could they possibly care about the affairs of a Jade Immortal?

Even if the Ancestral Master truly paid attention, Lin Yuan would simply discard this Taiyang Divine Spirit body without much loss.

Using the Cave Dwelling Jade Token.

Lin Yuan quickly entered the Grade A Cave Mansion.

This was a vast expanse of land, nearly a million miles in size, filled with Immortal Qi so dense it was nearly tangible.

Ordinary mortals living in such an environment would, even without practice, eventually transform their fleshly bodies into those of immortals over time.

Lin Yuan was not particularly interested in the swirling Immortal Qi.

The so-called Immortal Qi was but one form of energy, and after obtaining the numerous resources prepared by Yun Zhenzi, Lin Yuan did not lack energy input for the short term.

Thunderous rumbles.

Lin Yuan appeared in the center of the mansion, looking up at the sky.

There, a giant irregular fissure vaguely existed, where intense rule fluctuations visible to the naked eye emanated from the fissure.

“This crack must be the connection to the Origin of the Immortal Realm, opened by the Ancestral Master.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts ebbed and flowed, recognizing that even at his peak, he could not tear apart this fissure.

The Primordial Lands of the Main Universe were unreachable even for a twelfth-layer ultimate being.

Because the Main Universe was too powerful, and a twelfth-layer ultimate being could not approach the Primordial Lands.

And the Immortal Realm? Although it was close to the Main Universe, it was only close.

A twelfth-layer ultimate being exerting full force could still forcibly create a passage from the Primordial Lands to the outside world.

Among the many mansions within Cangwu Immortal City, only a Grade A Mansion could directly face the irregular fissure and experience the fluctuation of the rules from the Origin Power at close range.

As for the Grade B and Grade C Mansions, they could only indirectly sense the rule fluctuations emanating from the irregular fissure.

“The cultivation environment here is better than in the Main Universe, at least when it comes to the clarity and visibility of understanding the rules,” Lin Yuan’s spirit was slightly stirred.

Although the Immortal Realm could not match the Main Universe, in this moment, it opened almost completely to Lin Yuan, and in terms of understanding rules, the Main Universe naturally could not compare to the Immortal Realm.

“Given such an environment, I cannot guarantee mastery of the Chaos Rule, but the Seventh Realm of space and time? The time it takes to comprehend it should be much shorter than in the Main Universe.”

Lin Yuan was very confident.

“Let’s start cultivating now.”

Lin Yuan sat down cross-legged without delay, beginning to sense the rule fluctuations revealed from the irregular fissure above the sky.

Time for cultivation flowed like water, and before he knew it, five hundred years had passed.
